spans.s: Non-injunction, a mere statement (of something already known); देशकालानामचोदनं प्रयोगे नित्यसमवायात् [[
(?) Probably a special messenger to report among other things, impending attacks from enemies; Sircar,
a. Ved. [नास्ति चोदना यस्य] Spontaneous, not influenced by external force or compulsion. अचोदसो न धन्वन्त्विन्दवः [[
